author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a new development in the whole age verification fiasco. Apple and to a lesser extent Google have been pushing for users and developers to reveal their identities when downloading apps or in some cases releasing them (even outside of the play store). This needs to end and it needs to end fast. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Apple And Google Are Doing Global Age Verification...
